headline: Anthropic has added a ban on "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward its Claude models to its usage policy.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a notable policy step on AI welfare, but its practical effect is unclear.
importance_line: Claude users must now avoid sustained cruelty to the model, though the company has not said what counts as abusive, and whether AI can be harmed at all is still contested.
summary: The Guardian reports that Anthropic's online usage policy now bars users from "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward its AI models, with exceptions for common frustration, model testing and "dark creative themes". An Anthropic spokesperson did not immediately say what counts as abusive, and the company says it remains "highly uncertain" about the moral status of Claude and other models.
